note: Weekly consultation windows in the firm's local time. A window is when an attorney can take first consultations; actual slots are cut from it by the booking code.

booking.bufferNote: Gap after each consultation = that consultation's length (area consult.minutes) + bufferMinutes. Family/estate 45+15 = 60; injury/employment 30+15 = 45. Counted once, from the earlier consultation's end. The rules code and tests must match this exactly.
